name: X5 + Neo
summary: The A. O. Smith X5+Neo is a premium under-the-counter 100% RO water purifier featuring Copper Fortified MIN-TECH Mineralizer and 6-stage purification .
intro: The A. O. Smith X5+Neo is a premium under-the-counter RO water purifier designed to give your kitchen a clean, modern look. Equipped with 6-stage purification, Copper Fortified MIN-TECH Mineralizer, and a Side Stream RO membrane, it delivers 100% RO purified water enriched with essential minerals while achieving up to 40% water recovery.

rows: Pre-filter + ART™ MAX + Sediment Filter + Carbon Block + Side Stream RO + Copper Fortified Mineralizer
